name: Ledger
signature: Editorial finance: a quiet serif headline voice over a precise sans, deep evergreen accent, hairline rules instead of shadows, tabular figures everywhere money appears.

personality.typeVoice: A measured book serif for claims; a plain grotesque for work.

owned: Serif display at weight 500, never bold
Hairline 1px rules separate sections; no drop shadows on cards
All currency and metrics in tabular mono figures
Evergreen accent used only on forward actions and positive deltas
